linkFromLanding: See how accurately Kavach reads real policies
title: How accurately Kavach reads real policies
intro: We run Kavach's document reader on real, public Indian health insurance wordings and compare every term it reads with labels a person checked against the PDF.
fixtureBanner: This run used recorded test answers, not the live model. It proves the pipeline works; it is not an accuracy score. Real numbers appear after the next live run.
noLabels: No field has a checked label yet, so there is nothing to score.
perFieldIntro: Each bar is the share of wordings where Kavach read that term exactly as labelled.
wordingsIntro: Public documents filed with IRDAI or published by the insurer, identified by their UIN.
rulesIntro: Every amount Kavach shows comes from these rules, not from the AI. A rule is marked verified only after a person checks it against the primary source.
rulesIndia: India: IRDAI rules and policy wordings
rulesSingapore: Singapore: MediShield Life, Shield plan and rider rules

method.dataset: Dataset: {count} public policy wordings from {insurers} insurers, including group, senior citizen, super top-up and the IRDAI standard product. The PDFs are not stored in our repository; a script fetches them by URL and checks their fingerprint.
method.labels: Labels: for each wording an AI pre-fills about ten terms with the page and a quote; a person then checks every one against the PDF. Only checked labels count.
method.scoring: Scoring: exact match per field. Limits written as a percentage of the sum insured are compared at a sum insured of ₹5,00,000.
method.spoken: Spoken amounts: rehearsal recordings are transcribed and every rupee amount spoken is compared with the engine's answer, offline.
method.code: The eval code, labels and results are in the evals folder on GitHub.

honestTitle: What this does not show yet
honest: A test set of {count} wordings is small; we say so rather than round it up. Citation accuracy and the verifier catch rate are not measured on this page yet.
